item.title: [MEDIUM] Signed Overwolf Binary Sideloads ValleyRAT Malware in India
item.description: A phishing campaign targets Indian organizations by impersonating the Indian Income Tax Department. Victims receive emails containing links to spoofed notice pages that download ZIP archives. These archives include a legitimately signed Overwolf executable and two hidden files: a malicious DLL and an encrypted binary.
